grafanaUrl.title: Grafana URL
grafanaUrl.description: Base URL of your Grafana instance, e.g. https://grafana.example.com

serviceAccountToken.title: Grafana service account token
serviceAccountToken.description: Token of a Grafana service account. A Viewer role is enough; the server exposes read-only tools only.

orgId.title: Grafana organization ID
orgId.description: Optional. Grafana organization to use when the token has access to more than one.
